description.en: Local-first relationship genealogy. Turns your WeChat records into a queryable graph of PEOPLE — who knows whom, which groups they co-occur in, what you promised whom, when you last talked. CLI + 127.0.0.1-only HTTP API for any agent. Ships with synthetic demo data so you can try it before configuring anything.
description.zh: 本地优先的人脉谱系。把微信记录变成一张「人」的图谱——谁是谁的人、在哪些群共现、答应过什么、上次聊到哪。CLI + 仅绑本机的 HTTP API，任何 agent 可查可写。出厂自带演示数据，不配任何东西就能先试。

description.en: Synthetic data — works out of the box, no WeChat required.
description.zh: 合成演示数据 — 出厂即可跑，不需要微信。

description.en: WeChat 4.x local SQLCipher DB. Read-only; the source database is never modified.
description.zh: 微信 4.x 本地 SQLCipher 库。只读，绝不修改源数据库。

positioning.zh: 回答「他是谁的人」，不是「今天该做什么」。与情报日报类工具互补不重叠。
positioning.en: Answers 'who is this person to me', not 'what should I do today'. Complementary to daily-intelligence tools, not overlapping.
